title: Keep butchering out of the kitchen
applies_when: Cooking and butchering facilities are being placed or food poisoning recurs.
approach: Put the butcher table near food storage but in a separate room from the stove. The table itself lowers room cleanliness.
Keep the cooking room easy to clean and out of routine through-traffic. Assign cleaning; a floor does not clean itself.
Set a butcher-creature bill for appropriate fresh animal corpses. A butcher table alone will not produce meat.
verify: Room cleanliness, cook skill, corpse filters and the reported cause of food poisoning.
reconsider: The cook is unskilled, the kitchen remains dirty, or carcasses cannot be processed before rot.
